limits: Origin audit only; no QA01, QA06, live backend, physical device, release, product fidelity or feature acceptance.
Every registered route was rendered at 390x844, including unavailable and placeholder presentations. Unimplemented routes are not waived.
Component previews use existing deterministic producers; isolated status view props do not establish real maintenance/recovery behavior.
The initial generic driver assumed #root. The primitive and control-layout fixtures mount elsewhere; both were captured successfully by state-capture.mjs.
Other preview failures require their original HTTP/asset producer. They are preserved as NOT_RUN; current route gates and all tracked visual source remain audited.
Exact hashes and normalized token windows cannot prove originality of transformed or reencoded assets. Manual source/visual review supplies the bounded additional evidence.

No new snapshots were adopted as golden files and no visual assertion was weakened. Refreshed route/mobile files supersede initial files with the same names; browser-current.json is authoritative for those artifacts.
Future rendering changes require renewed origin review.
